statement: The CLI service pipeline's build stage finalizes the generated binding records it deploys: after stampArtifactDescriptor writes the real artifact descriptor into manifest.json, runBuild restamps every generated binding target's manifest_digest in bindings.json to the canonical sha256 digest of the stamped normalized manifest, computed by the deployment-record generator's single digest owner (manifestDigestOf semantics), so the public generate->build->deploy path produces CREATE BINDING statements whose pinned digest equals the ServiceInstallCatalogOwner's stored manifestDigest for a genuinely built wasm component. Verified at HEAD df0461143: runGenerate always digests the placeholderArtifact() manifest, runBuild stamps only manifest.json, runDeploy substitutes only package_id, so CREATE BINDING deterministically fails PACKAGE_STATE_CORRUPT on the CLI path (live witness public-path-multinode-baseline-20260811T090119Z; restamp-digest equality with the stored catalog row proven empirically). A deterministic red-on-revert test proves the restamped binding digest equals the catalog projection digest and fails when the restamp is reverted; the binding contract's digest pinning (minimal-deployment-binding-v0-declaration) is not weakened.
